note.question: How do committing to customer orders affect online retail?
note.overview: Online retailers are on a consistent drive to increase on-time delivery and reduce customer lead time. However, in reality, an increasing share of consumers places orders early. Such advance demand information can be deployed strategically to reduce costs and improve the customer service experience.
